about: People-scale ladder. 'have' = built and proven here (evidence must exist), 'dormant' = built but off until the tier needs it, 'gap' = NOT built: the honest list of what you would add or buy. Headcounts are guidance bands, not guarantees; capacity numbers come from `./securax scale --bench` on YOUR hardware.

capabilities.name: Guardrail gateway + audit
Safe update with rollback, backups
Single-pane cockpit, plain-words digest
Live multi-device sync (WebSocket + pull fallback)

tiers.shape: one strong server (or two), Compose, Tailscale for access
tiers.toil: low: weekly look at the cockpit, digest in chat

capabilities.name: Team chat + ChatOps (Mattermost organ, webhook digest)
Per-person identity at the gateway (API keys / OIDC JWT, roles, MFA claim)
Audit trail with who/what/when
Backups to a separate disk
Per-person usage quotas / fair-share
capabilities.next: per-subject rate limit in the gateway keyed by the audited subject

tiers.shape: 2-3 gateway replicas behind a load balancer; managed or replicated Postgres
tiers.humans: a small platform group (2-3) with an on-call rota
tiers.toil: moderate: patching windows, capacity review monthly

capabilities.name: Company SSO (Entra ID / Google / Keycloak) through OIDC JWT at the gateway
Kubernetes (k3s burrow) with per-tenant quota and network policy
Autoscaling on load (KEDA)
Metrics and alert rules (Prometheus stack)
Runtime threat detection and policy (Falco, Kyverno)
Mattermost for >250 people, SSO and HA clustering
capabilities.next: needs a paid Mattermost licence: confirm current edition terms with the vendor before committing

capabilities.name: Live sync across several estate-sync replicas
capabilities.next: estate-sync holds its socket registry in-process and uses SQLite: move to Postgres + a pub/sub bus before running more than one replica

capabilities.name: Connection pooling and read replicas for Postgres
capabilities.next: PgBouncer + one replica; add when the DB shows connection pressure

tiers.shape: multi-node Kubernetes, one cell per business unit or tenant (GitOps)
tiers.humans: a platform team (5-15) plus a SOC; security operations by shifts
tiers.toil: managed by GitOps: change = pull request

capabilities.name: Tenant cells from one Helm chart, GitOps app-of-apps, drift healed by Argo CD
Usage metering per tenant (chargeback)
Backups and restore for clusters (Velero)
Data residency by class and region, enforced in the gateway and in cloud apply
Regulatory incident clock with chained evidence
SIEM and incident response organs (Wazuh, TheHive, MISP)
Central logs and distributed tracing backend (OpenTelemetry collector)
capabilities.next: W3C trace context is already propagated; add a collector + store (Loki/Tempo or your SIEM) and export from the gateway

capabilities.name: SCIM user provisioning and de-provisioning
capabilities.next: joiner/mover/leaver is manual: front the gateway with your IdP's groups, add SCIM when headcount makes manual removal a risk

capabilities.name: Canary and blue-green releases
capabilities.next: Argo Rollouts on the tenant chart; today it is rolling update + the safe-update rollback

tiers.shape: multi-region cells on cloud (canopy), dedicated inference fleet
tiers.humans: an SRE organisation, 24x7; this repository is a blueprint here, not a turnkey product

capabilities.name: Cloud genomes (AWS full, GCP/Azure skeleton) with dormancy and region allow-list proofs
Multi-region active-active, global load balancing
capabilities.next: design per region cell; keep data residency classes as the routing key

capabilities.name: Dedicated GPU inference tier with queueing and batching (vLLM/TGI class)
capabilities.next: LiteLLM can front it; capacity planning must be measured, not assumed

capabilities.name: Cost governance (FinOps) with per-team budgets and hard stops
capabilities.next: metering exists; add budgets and enforcement

capabilities.name: Formal SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, game days at scale
capabilities.next: fitness checks and game days exist for one estate; SLO tooling is yours to add
